bH.text: A simple version is this. Just name the aiming costume "Aiming" and the normal costume "Normal." Remember, for the Aiming costume, make sure that the sights are in the centre of the editing screen. And, in the Normal costume, make sure that the gun is near the middle of the screen.

bJ.text: For burst-fire. (I am aware that M9's are not burst-fire).

bN.text: If you want a faster sway, make this number slightly bigger. But make sure it's less than 1 and bigger than 0.
